# FG-DB-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`db-unavailable`](../../ops/runbooks/db-unavailable.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_slow_statement_is_db_query_failed_with_sqlstate_57014` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データベースの処理に失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A database operation failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Operasi basis data gagal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A statement failed on a working connection: it exceeded database.statement_timeout_ms (SQLSTATE 57014) or database.lock_timeout_ms (55P03), lost a serialization race (40001) or a deadlock (40P01), violated a constraint (23xxx), found no row where one must exist, or the server reported another error. (A lost connection is FG-DB-0001.)

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `query` (a static name of the statement — never its SQL text or parameters), `reason` (statement_timeout, lock_timeout, serialization, deadlock, constraint with `constraint` / `table`, row_not_found, server_error, client_error — e.g. a decode error) and `sqlstate`. Row values are never logged: for classes 22 / 23 the server message is dropped. For timeouts, look for long-running or blocking sessions in pg_stat_activity and pg_locks at that time; look up other SQLSTATEs in the PostgreSQL documentation.

## 対処 (fix)

For timeouts remove the blocking session or fix the slow plan (EXPLAIN); serialization and deadlock are safe to retry; for constraint and other states fix the caller named by `query`.
